towns.name: Sawato
towns.summary: Sawato is a Sho village hidden in a clearing of the Blackmire Swamp. After the warlord Ijiku Tambai's fortress Yaosai (now Shoushi) pushed the Mosswarts back into the swamp, bold settlers founded Sawato on the new frontier, and its road finally joined long-isolated Yanshi to the Sho lands. For years it was one of the most inaccessible towns in Dereth (only the meeting-hall portal); it is home to Tsua Kagemata the Sho mask maker and to the Sawato Bandit extortion quest. In the DAT the village is a ~120 m packed-dirt clearing at z 12 ringed by a sea of swamp cypress (canopy 25-44 m) and still pools (WaterStandingFresh at z 6). Sho houses with green tiled roofs - octagon halls, spire-roofed houses, a green-roofed hall with a dome and archways, a mossy stone church and the meeting hall - surround a square with the Nullified Statue of a Sclavus on its pedestal ringed by three small trees, the Life Stone, the Town Network portal, the Jojii Shrine, a well, and street lanterns whose warm glow halos (0x020005B2) light the square.
